en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
zh: 修复了 `/terminal-setup` 在块注释附近损坏 VS Code 设置或 keybindings 文件的问题，以及当 keybindings.json 中存在未闭合字符串时报告成功却丢失 Shift+Enter 绑定的问题
